name: k8s_ingress
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes Ingress — an HTTP/HTTPS routing rule set that exposes services within an environment or resource group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this Ingress.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Kubernetes Ingress resource.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the Ingress is created.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (Kubernetes cluster) this Ingress belongs to.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the Ingress is created in.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the Ingress.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the Ingress (e.g. nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target).

attributes.name: ingress_class_name
attributes.description: Name of the IngressClass cluster resource (e.g. nginx, alb).

attributes.name: default_backend
attributes.description: Default backend to forward traffic to when no rule matches.

attributes.name: service
attributes.description: Service backend for the default backend.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Kubernetes Service name to route traffic to.

attributes.name: port
attributes.description: Port on the referenced service.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Named port on the service.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Numeric port on the service.

attributes.name: rules
attributes.description: List of host rules that define how traffic is routed to backend services.

attributes.name: host
attributes.description: Hostname for this rule (e.g. api.example.com). Omit to match all hosts.

attributes.name: http
attributes.description: HTTP path-based routing rules for this host.

attributes.name: paths
attributes.description: List of path-to-backend mappings.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: URL path to match (e.g. /api).

attributes.name: path_type
attributes.description: Path matching semantics: Exact, Prefix, or ImplementationSpecific.

attributes.name: backend
attributes.description: Backend to route matched traffic to.

attributes.name: service
attributes.description: Service backend.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Kubernetes Service name.

attributes.name: port
attributes.description: Port on the referenced service.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Named port on the service.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Numeric port on the service.

attributes.name: tls
attributes.description: TLS configuration blocks, each pairing a list of hosts with a certificate secret.

attributes.name: hosts
attributes.description: Hostnames covered by this TLS certificate.

attributes.name: secret_name
attributes.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret containing the TLS certificate and key.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the Ingress resource.
